high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article or a section from a website discussing the views of Yann LeCun on large language models (LLMs). The text at the top of the image provides context about LeCun's perspective on LLMs, describing them as "limited 'autocomplete machines'" that lack foundational cognitive abilities such as reasoning, planning, and causal understanding. This stance contrasts with the industry narrative that positions LLMs as the foundation for future artificial general intelligence (AGI). Below the text, there is a graphic titled "EASY GUIDE TO WHAT IS LLM.
